When Hermes may phone you, and how a call rings

When a job you asked about is done, Hermes calls you so you can talk it through. This phone rings like a phone call; where it can\'t, a “Hermes wants to talk” notification comes instead: tap Talk to answer.
Turn on notifications for this profile first, in Settings under Notifications: Hermes calls you through them.
Off, a “Hermes wants to talk” notification comes instead: tap Talk to answer.
Show the call screen when locked
Android asks before an app\'s call screen shows over the lock screen. Without it, a call rings as a notification.
Ask Hermes in a chat to call you when something is done. Hermes calls about that job once it finishes.
Hermes may also call on its own when news can\'t wait, within your limits. It never calls for routine updates.
Hermes calls when it has waited a minute for your OK or an answer, or when a request fails.
Past a limit, a finished job sends its usual notification instead of calling. These settings are this profile\'s, kept on your Hermes host.
For example: only if production is down or a deploy fails. Never before 9 am.
Hermes reads this before each call it decides to make, and calls only if the news fits. Calls you ask for don\'t depend on it.
Call me now to test calls.
Opens a new chat with “%1$s” ready to send. Send it, and this phone rings when Hermes replies.
Make my scheduled checks that call me match this note. Update the ones I already have instead of adding new ones:\n%1$s

Hermes doesn\'t check for what your note describes on its own. This opens a new chat asking it to set up scheduled checks that call you when it happens. After you change the note, tap it again to bring the checks up to date.
Ask in any chat: “Call me when the tests finish.” This phone rings once the job is done, and answering opens voice in that chat.

To be called when something happens, ask Hermes to watch for it: “Check my homelab every 5 minutes and call me if it\'s down for more than 10 minutes.” Hermes sets up a scheduled check that calls you.
To let Hermes call on its own, turn on Hermes decides when to call and write what\'s worth a call. Hermes checks your note before each call it decides to make.
To let Hermes call on its own when news can\'t wait, turn on Hermes decides when to call.
If you decline or miss a call, Hermes knows the next time you write in that chat.

Share your calendar, Do Not Disturb and phone status with Hermes

Share your calendar, Do Not Disturb and phone status with Hermes, so your agent can plan around your day and pick good moments to reach you. It goes straight from this phone to your Hermes host, sealed end to end, never through the notification relay.
Share your calendar and phone with Hermes?
What you choose here goes to the %1$s profile on %2$s, sealed end to end. It never goes through the notification relay, and nobody else can read it. Nothing is shared until you turn each part on.
Hermes reads events from the last week and the time ahead you choose, and can ask to add or change them.
Hermes can ask to add events but can\'t read your calendar.
Calendar access is off for this app. Allow it in the phone\'s settings to share.
Without these, Hermes gets titles, times and places, not what\'s written in notes or who\'s invited.
Hermes always asks before it changes or deletes anything.
Do Not Disturb and phone status
Whether Do Not Disturb is on and holds calls; battery and charging, power saver, Android Auto, headphones or Bluetooth, and Wi-Fi or mobile data. Only the latest state is kept.
The app stops sending your calendar and phone status, and Hermes can\'t ask for calendar changes. Deleting removes what this phone sent from the host.
Turn off and delete from the host
Turn off, keep data on the host
Let Hermes set alarms and timers

They ring from this app like the clock\'s, even in Do Not Disturb. Hermes asks each time unless new items go in without asking, and always asks before cancelling one. Hermes sees only the alarms it set.
Android doesn\'t let this app ring at exact times yet.

Pick the people Hermes should know: it gets their name, numbers, email addresses and birthday, and their nickname and company when the contact has them. The app reads only the people you pick; on Android 16 and older, Android asks for contacts access first.
Contacts access is off, so the app can\'t read the people you pick.
Where you are, your saved places, and when Hermes read it

Let Hermes know where you are, so it can answer “what\'s near me”, work out travel times and remind you at places. Your location goes straight from this phone to your Hermes host, sealed end to end, and never through the notification relay.
Connect to your Hermes dashboard first.
Paused until you turn it back on.
Paused: sign in to this dashboard again. Location is sent again once you open the app.
Paused: update the push plugin on this host to share your location.
Paused: the host refused location data (%1$s).
Location access is off for this app. Allow it in Android\'s settings.
Sharing in the background needs location access set to “Allow all the time”. Change it in Android\'s settings.
Only approximate location is allowed for this app, so saved places and Precise aren\'t available. Area still works.
Share while I\'m talking to Hermes
A position is sent when you send a message or start a voice conversation, and as you move during one. Needs location access while using the app.
Arriving at and leaving your saved places, and longer moves. Lets Hermes run place rules and know where you are when it needs to. Needs location access “Allow all the time”.
Hermes can\'t ask this phone for a fresh position yet; it uses the last one sent.
Hermes hears only which of your saved places you\'re at, and your phone\'s time zone.
Your neighbourhood and city, a position to about 1 km, and distances to your saved places.
Your position as your phone measures it, and distances to your saved places.
Up to 20. Where they are stays on this phone: Hermes gets only their names, and at a private place only “at a private place”. Saved places need background sharing to report arriving and leaving.
While paused nothing is sent, Hermes is told sharing is paused, and place rules don\'t run.
How long the host keeps the places you\'ve been. Your latest position is always kept until you delete it; there is never a record of every position.
Hermes hasn\'t read your location yet.
Every time Hermes reads your location it\'s listed here, for 30 days. The list never holds the location itself.
Asked your phone where you are
No place rules. Teach Hermes what to do at your places, for example: “When I get to the gym, remind me to log my workout.”
Delete location data on the host?
Hermes can no longer read what was deleted. Sharing stays as it is; turn the layers off first to stop sending.
This app sends your location, at the detail you choose, to the %1$s profile on %2$s, sealed end to end. It never goes through the notification relay, and the app\'s developer can\'t see it.
Your phone\'s time zone is always sent too, at every level of detail, so Hermes knows your local time. At Area and Precise, so are distances to your saved places, except private ones.
Your agent reads it when you ask, or when a task or place rule needs it. Whatever it reads goes to the AI model provider your Hermes uses, under that provider\'s terms.
If your Hermes is hosted by someone else, such as Hermes Cloud, they can read it too.
Every read is listed in Settings › Location. You can pause sharing, turn it off and delete what was sent at any time. Your location is never used for advertising.
At a private place Hermes hears only “at a private place”, never its name or where it is, and your visits there aren\'t kept.
Not placed yet: use your current location or search for an address.
Couldn\'t find your position. Try searching for the address.
Couldn\'t search for addresses. Try again.
Arriving and leaving count once you cross this circle. A larger circle notices you sooner but can miss short visits.
Activity, heart, sleep and workouts from Health Connect

Share health data from Health Connect with Hermes so your agent can answer questions about your activity, sleep and workouts. It goes straight from this phone to your Hermes host, sealed end to end, and never through the notification relay.
Health Connect isn\'t available on this phone.
Health Connect needs an update before health data can be shared.
The app stops sending health data. Deleting removes what this phone sent from the host; Hermes can no longer read it.
Turn off and delete from the host
Turn off, keep data on the host
Sharing is off, but the host couldn\'t be reached to delete what was sent. Turn it on and off again to delete it.
This app sends the health data you choose to the %1$s profile on %2$s, sealed end to end. It never goes through the notification relay, and the app\'s developer can\'t see it.

Your agent reads it when you ask, or when a task needs it. Whatever it reads goes to the AI model provider your Hermes uses, under that provider\'s terms. If your Hermes is hosted by someone else, such as Hermes Cloud, they can read it too.
Health data is never used for advertising.
You can turn sharing off at any time here and delete what was sent from the host.
Paused: sign in to this dashboard again. Sharing catches up when you open the app.
Paused: update the push plugin on this host to share health data.
Paused: the host refused health data (%1$s).
Paused: Health Connect didn\'t let the app read. Allow access below or in Health Connect.
Health Connect doesn\'t allow everything you chose to share yet.
Health Connect doesn\'t let the app read in the background yet, so health data goes only while the app is open.

Hermes gets hourly and daily summaries computed by Health Connect, a summary of each night\'s sleep, and each workout. Detailed readings add every individual measurement, such as each heart rate reading.
Turning a category off or shortening the history only stops new uploads. What was already sent stays on the host until you turn off sharing and delete it.
How far back the first sync reaches. A long history comes in over a few days in the background. Hourly detail covers the last 30 days; older history is daily.
Steps, distance walked or run and cycled, active energy, floors climbed
Time asleep and in bed, sleep stages
Each workout: type, time, duration, energy, distance, heart rate
